theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bvc_limit_of_fast_cauchy
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Gs : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Gs j)) → (∀ i : ℕ, volume (symmDiff (Gs (i + 1)) (Gs i) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) ((i : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i) → ∃ F₀ : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet F₀ ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => volume (symmDiff (Gs j) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
